category_feedback.specific_evidence: lesson_specific_materials lists 'Detective Dot and Tally puppets' as a required item, with no optional/no-puppet alternative. The rubric explicitly flags REQUIRED puppets as a Level 2 disqualifier because most Canadian K-3 classrooms do not have puppets on hand.
category_feedback.required_fix: Make the puppets explicitly OPTIONAL in lesson_specific_materials (e.g., 'OPTIONAL: Detective Dot and Tally puppets — if no puppets, use two stuffed animals, paper-bag puppets, or just point to the Data Detectives Poster while voicing the characters'). Mirror this in the minds_on teacher_script so a teacher with zero prep can run the hook with voice-and-poster only.

summary: Lesson 2 teaches the 4+1 tally cross convention well — real G1 no-cross trap, concrete recovery, child-friendly voice, and the worksheet practises the same three success criteria (read tallies, survey, total by 5s). Blocking issue: lesson_specific_materials REQUIRES Detective Dot and Tally puppets, which the rubric flags as Level 2. Mark puppets OPTIONAL with a no-puppet alternative path (stuffed animal or pointing to the poster) and this pair passes.
